history.summary: A large 646-unit 99-year leasehold condo in Simei (D18), 550m from EW3 Simei MRT, with a deep 139-txn URA series and 6.0%/yr appreciation. This 4BR at $1,568 psf sits ~7% above the $1,468 median, and a $2.45M leasehold 4BR is a narrower exit than the dossier's liquidity suggests.
history.rating_rationale: Double Bay is a large, well-known Simei development with genuine liquidity — 139 URA transactions and 646 units underpin a 6.0%/yr resale rate you can trust, and EW3 Simei MRT at 550m plus the upcoming Eastern Region amenities support demand. The reservations: this specific 4BR is listed at $1,568 psf, ~7% ABOVE the $1,468 project median (so you're paying a premium, not getting a discount), and at $2.45M for a 99-year leasehold (2012, ~85 years left but OCR) the 4BR buyer pool in Simei is thinner than the 2-3BR resale market. Large family units in OCR appreciate more slowly per sqft. Solid asset, but priced above median and the wrong unit type for maximum liquidity — Neutral.
red_flags: Listed ~7% above the project URA median — paying a premium
$2.45M 4BR is a narrower OCR exit than the dev's 2-3BR market
Leasehold; OCR large-family units appreciate slower per sqft
catalysts: EW3 Simei MRT 550m, near Changi Business Park / SUTD / Eastern General Hospital (opening)
Large 646-unit development = deep buyer pool and amenities
